name: What defines a penthouse apartment?

acceptedAnswer.text: A penthouse apartment typically occupies the highest floor of a multi-story building, offering panoramic views, larger living spaces, and often exclusive outdoor areas like private terraces or rooftops. These properties often include premium finishes, unique architectural designs, and enhanced amenities compared to other units in the same building. Understanding these defining features helps buyers prioritize their search, especially when considering luxury properties in areas like Miami Beach or Fort Lauderdale, where diverse building styles exist.
acceptedAnswer.description: A penthouse is a luxury apartment on the top floor of a building, usually with expansive views, larger spaces, and exclusive outdoor areas.
